name: Finishing
desc: An open hand. Pinky and ring finger: dunks. Middle finger: layups. Index and thumb: floaters, hooks and push shots. All three meet at the tip of the middle finger: Unstoppable. Dunk styles (tomahawk, windmill, 360…) unlock with your Dunk rating.

nodes.name: Power Dunker
nodes.desc: Dunks x1.06, contest on dunks x0.85.

nodes.name: Lob Threat
nodes.desc: Alley-oops: catch window +0.8 ft and alley-oop finishes x1.10.

nodes.name: Posterizer
nodes.desc: Contested dunks x1.15. A made contested dunk staggers the defender.

nodes.name: Jelly Fake
nodes.desc: Going up for a dunk, press ✕ again: abort it, hang in the air and flick a jelly layup instead. Shot blockers who jumped at the dunk come down before it's released (they can't block it and barely contest it), but the jelly is a much harder shot.

nodes.name: Euro Step
nodes.desc: Shoot near the rim while holding the stick sideways = Euro Step layup (weaker contest).

nodes.name: Sky Hook
nodes.desc: Hooks x1.10, contest on hooks x0.85.

nodes.name: Dreamer
nodes.desc: Pump fake (✕ tap) your hook, floater and layup with their own fakes: the stick picks the shot you sell (away = floater, toward = layup, sideways = hook). Defenders bite on them 35% more.

nodes.name: Step-Through
nodes.desc: Everyone can Step-Through (pump fake, then hold the stick toward the rim + shoot). This perk makes the stride longer (5.5 -> 7 ft) and the finish better (x1.12).

nodes.name: Unstoppable
nodes.desc: Nobody blocks you: a shot that would be blocked is only contested, and every contest on your shots is x0.75.
